description:
Thanks to Meter for sponsoring today's episode. If you're interested in learning more about how Meter can help with your IT Infrastructure, go to https://meter.com/craftcomputing to book a demo today.

The Nvidia Tesla P4 is one of the best addons for your homelab. It's a great for video encoding and decoding, and can even be used for gaming through Nvidia GRID. Today, we're running it on my Supermicro X79 Microcloud to see if this 9 year old card still has what it takes to run modern games.

But first... What am I drinking???

Coffee. And it's nice and hot thanks to my Insulated Tumbler from https://craftcomputing.store
